candidates.title: Norway government proposes temporary AI-glasses restrictions in selected public places
candidates.summary: Norway's Ministry of Digitalisation and Public Governance says it will bring a bill to Parliament for a temporary ban on AI glasses in selected public and privacy-sensitive places while an expert group develops longer-term body-worn-technology regulation. Scope and covered technologies remain to be defined.

candidates.title: OpenVision 2.14 adds ChatGPT/SuperGrok sign-in and follows with Keychain credential fix
candidates.summary: The third-party MIT-licensed iOS companion for Meta glasses added subscription sign-in paths and Grok support; subsequent main-branch work moved API keys/tokens out of plaintext settings into iOS Keychain. The project warns its ChatGPT subscription route uses an undocumented Codex CLI integration surface and can break.

candidates.title: SmartGlasses community debates Norway's proposed camera-glasses restrictions
candidates.summary: A new r/SmartGlasses thread asks whether camera glasses should be temporarily banned in selected places, using Norway's proposal as the prompt. Preserve as community reaction only; the policy facts are independently anchored to the Norwegian government source.
